correctness.rationale: For every m>=2, valuation parity gives exactly two cyclic block families; the periodic family has n/2 distinct rotations and distinct profiles, and the primitive family has n. Explicit formulas reduce all one-gap counts to (k,T+F,F+L). A rotation-shift Diophantine identity forces collision displacement +/-3; parity excludes even m, while odd m collisions correspond bijectively to cyclic 10101 patterns. The latter are counted exactly by odd valuations >=3, yielding (n+4)/12 nonoverlapping doubletons. The m=2 edge case is covered. Independent enumeration matches m=2..9; the infinite proof does not rest on testing.

value.rationale: The 2023 gapped-binomial model poses natural exact reconstruction questions for classical automatic infinite words. At the canonical dyadic lengths, the result fully determines whether the observation distinguishes factors and exactly counts every ambiguity class; the odd-even alternation and explicit 10101 obstruction are structural, not a mere finite enumeration. It sharpens the loss from a finer known observable to the natural gapped one without claiming a broader conjecture.
